apps.name: Tuna
apps.subtitle: Your music at home.
apps.localizedDescription: Your music from your Tuna server, with mixes and lyrics. Download songs to play offline.

versions.localizedDescription:
Changed
- Songs that aren't on an album Lidarr has (singles and EPs its metadata profile leaves out, songs MusicBrainz doesn't know) are now got from Soulseek all the same, and go straight into the music folder, named and tagged as the playlist has them. Before, Tuna gave up on them without looking. This needs slskd's downloads folder inside the data folder Tuna has (the log says if it isn't).
- One more search on Soulseek: the song's title alone, as people search (a copy still needs the artist in its path).

Fixed
- Long playlists scrolled slowly (a big Liked songs with many songs not here yet): songs off screen are no longer laid out or drawn until they come near, songs not here yet are dimmed in a way that's quicker to draw, and only the song playing hears about play and pause.
- The fish's tail was cut in the opening away from home (iPhone and Mac): as it swung, its rounded edge was clipped. It now swings about its tip.

To update: the server (pull the new image), and the apps for the tail.
